Job Description :




We are looking for passionate and experienced Agentic AI Engineers across Junior, Senior, and Lead levels to design, develop, and deploy next-generation AI agents using GitHub Copilot Agent SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework, and Python. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in building autonomous and multi-agent systems, integrating LLMs, implementing Agentic AI workflows, and delivering enterprise-grade AI solutions.

The role involves architecting intelligent agents, enabling agent-to-agent collaboration, integrating enterprise tools and data sources, implementing RAG solutions, and deploying scalable AI applications in cloud environments.

Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI agents using GitHub Copilot Agent SDK and Microsoft Agent Framework.
Build autonomous, multi-agent, and workflow-driven AI solutions for enterprise use cases.
Develop agent orchestration, tool-calling, function-calling, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
Implement memory management, context handling, and agent communication patterns.
Design and develop scalable backend services using Python and FastAPI.
Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions using vector databases and semantic search techniques.
Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and external tools.
Develop and optimize prompt engineering strategies for improved agent performance.
Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI agent deployments.
Monitor, evaluate, and continuously improve agent performance, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Product, QA, Engineering, and DevOps teams.
Contribute to architecture design, technical documentation, and best practices for Agentic AI development.

Skills and Qualifications

2.5+ years of experience in software engineering and AI solution development.
Strong hands-on experience in Python programming and software design principles.
Experience developing AI agents using GitHub Copilot Agent SDK and/or Microsoft Agent Framework.
Strong understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including autonomous agents, orchestration, memory, planning, and reasoning.
Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI application development.
Hands-on experience building REST APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks.
Experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions.
Strong problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills.
Experience with version control systems such as Git and GitHub.
Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft AI Foundry, Prompt Flow, and AI model deployment.
Knowledge of Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, and Azure cloud-native solutions.
Experience with Vector Databases such as Azure AI Search,
Understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and tool integration frameworks.
Hands-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.
Experience implementing enterprise-grade security, governance, and compliance controls for AI applications.
Knowledge of DevOps practices, GitHub Actions, and CI/CD automation.
Experience leading AI projects and mentoring engineering teams (Senior/Lead positions).
Bachelors or masters degree in computer science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.

Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with Microsoft AI Foundry Agent Services.
Experience building multi-agent ecosystems and autonomous workflow platforms.
Exposure to GitHub Copilot Extensions and enterprise AI integrations.
Knowledge of modern AI evaluation, observability, and monitoring frameworks.

Junior Agentic AI Engineer



Strong Python fundamentals.
Basic experience with LLMs and AI agent development.
API integration and workflow automation experience.
Ability to develop and support enterprise AI agents under guidance.
